mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS has declined for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 5.0% for two consecutive months, it signals weakening labor market conditions that prompt equity investors to reduce risk exposure, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 5.0% for two months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in retail sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates broad-based consumer and business spending weakness, which triggers a 60-day negative S&P 500 return as investors anticipate reduced corporate earnings.
failure_condition: The joint decline in RSAFS and HOUST fails to predict negative 60-day SPX returns in more than 50% of cases (Rank IC < 0.02).

mechanism_narrative: During periods of declining industrial production (INDPRO < 99.0) and rising unemployment (UNRATE > 4.8%), the S&P 500 experiences negative 20-day returns due to heightened recession risk and reduced corporate profitability.
failure_condition: In periods where INDPRO < 99.0 and UNRATE > 4.8%, SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year CPI inflation exceeds 2.5%, it signals persistent inflationary pressures that prompt the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY exceeds 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) over the past 6 months indicates a strengthening labor market, which supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods with PAYEMS growth for 6 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-demand regime characterized by rising retail sales (RSAFS > 450,000) and strong housing starts (HOUST > 1200), the S&P 500 experiences positive 60-day returns as consumer confidence fuels corporate revenue growth.
failure_condition: In periods where RSAFS > 450,000 and HOUST > 1200, SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and rise in unemployment (UNRATE) indicates a supply-side shock that reduces corporate output and profits, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in INDPRO and rise in UNRATE fails to predict negative 20-day SPX returns in more than 50% of cases (Rank IC < 0.02).
